F-02: OIDC Login Page CSP unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval
F-03: securityiq CSP in Report-Only Mode (Not Enforced)
F-04: Sensitive Configuration Files in Web Root (Nginx-Blocked)
F-05: Internal Server File Paths Disclosed in JavaScript Bundle
F-06: GraphQL Endpoint No Query Alias/Complexity Limiting
F-07: Internal Server Error on JSON-Accept Register Endpoint
F-08: OIDC Discovery Advertises none Token Endpoint Auth Method
A-01: BOLA Cross-Tenant User Enumeration via userConnection
A-02: BOLA Cross-Tenant User Fetch via user(id) + Alias Batching
A-03: BOLA Cross-Tenant Org Enumeration via orgConnection
A-04: BOLA Cross-Tenant Org Fetch via org(id)
A-05: Stored XSS Payloads in User Profile Fields
A-06: CSV Formula Injection in User Profile Fields
B-01: SecurityIQ CSP in Report-Only Mode
B-02: Staging S3 Bucket Referenced in Production CSP

OIDC Implicit Flow (response_type=id_token)
nodes.rationale: Deprecated by RFC 9700 / OAuth 2.0 Security BCP; exposes tokens to JavaScript on the relying party at form-post processing time, enabling token theft via XSS. PKCE authorization code flow is the mandated replacement.

nodes.label: BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization)
nodes.rationale: GraphQL resolvers (userConnection, user(id), orgConnection, org(id)) lack tenant-scoping filters, allowing cross-tenant data access. Server-side org membership check is required at each resolver.

nodes.label: BFLA (Broken Function Level Authorization)
nodes.rationale: Write mutations (userSessionRevoke, userUpdate, userDelete, userRoleUpdate, userInvite, orgInviteCreate, orgUpdate) correctly rejected cross-tenant targets with generic error messages.

nodes.label: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
nodes.rationale: unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval in CSP nullifies XSS protection. Stored XSS payloads found in givenName/familyName fields; React 18 auto-escapes in DOM but non-React consumers (email templates, PDF, dangerouslySetInnerHTML) remain vulnerable.

nodes.label: GraphQL Alias Batching (no rate limit)
nodes.rationale: No alias count or complexity limit enforced on GraphQL queries. Amplifies BOLA by enabling bulk exfiltration of arbitrary org users in a single HTTP request using field aliases.

nodes.label: CSP Report-Only Mode (no enforcement)
nodes.rationale: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only collects violations but does not block content. Both securityiq and account login page have this misconfiguration, rendering XSS protection non-operative.

nodes.label: CSV Formula Injection (DDE / spreadsheet injection)
nodes.rationale: userUpdate mutation allows storing =cmd|' /C calc'!A0 in name fields. If exported to CSV/Excel, triggers DDE formula execution on admin workstation.

nodes.label: TLS configuration (1.3 on account, 1.2 on securityiq)

hyperedges.label: Cross-Tenant Data Exfiltration Chain: A-01 + A-02 + F-06
hyperedges.description: A-01 (userConnection enumerates all foreign user IDs) feeds A-02 (user(id) fetches individual profiles cross-tenant), amplified by F-06 (alias batching enables bulk exfiltration of all users in a single HTTP request).

hyperedges.label: XSS-to-Token-Theft Chain: F-02 + F-03 + F-01
hyperedges.description: F-02 (unsafe-inline CSP on OIDC login page) and F-03 (no enforced CSP on securityiq) enable XSS execution; F-01 (implicit flow delivers id_token to JavaScript context) means a successful XSS can intercept the OIDC token and hijack the session.

hyperedges.label: OIDC SSO Authentication Flow: oidcLogin + oidc_issuer + state_nonce + id_token
hyperedges.description: Complete OIDC implicit flow: securityiq /users/oidcLogin redirects to account OIDC issuer with state+nonce, OIDC issues id_token via form_post, SecurityIQ callback validates state and establishes session via siq_sess cookie.
